title: Jets TE Kenyon Sadiq out "a little bit" due to setback after hernia surgery

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jets TE Kenyon Sadiq out "a little bit" due to setback after hernia surgery
sources.description: Jets first-round pick Kenyon Sadiq is not practicing on Tuesday for the third straight day and head coach Aaron Glenn said in his press conference that the rookie tight end will miss more time.
